000.$description: Used by: light surface.card (Sampled), light surface.cardAccount (Sampled), light surface.cardSuggestion (Sampled).

250.$description: Used by: light surface.bubbleLight (Sampled), light surface.cardUsage (Sampled).

1200.$description: Used by: dark button.primary (Sampled), dark surface.cardSuggestion (Sampled).

1300.$description: Used by: dark surface.bubble (Sampled), dark surface.cardUsage (Sampled).

1400.$description: Used by: dark bg.page (Sampled), light text.primary (Sampled (text)).

card.$description: Grouped settings cards: diagonal-inset reading 25.6pt in both themes. Plus or minus 2 pt.

cardSuggestion.$description: Suggestion and notebook cards: 23.9pt in both themes.

bubble.$description: The owner's message bubble: 39.3pt dark, 41.0pt light, on a 85.5pt two-line bubble. Read on two lines only; a one-line bubble may be a capsule.

sheet.$description: Top corners of a sheet: 37.6pt on the account sheet.

capsule.$description: Fully round ends: the composer (35.8pt on a 70 pt capsule), the account sheet's row cards (27.3pt on 54 pt), buttons, the Chat / Task pill, switches, the PRO badge, glass nav buttons and the search field.

xs.$description: Gap between a row title and its subtitle, and inside badges.

md.$description: Gap between stacked cards: suggestion cards and the account sheet's row cards sit 12.5 pt apart.

lg.$description: Screen margin: grouped and suggestion cards start 16 pt from the screen edge, the reply text 24 pt.

xl.$description: Inner padding of a suggestion card: its title starts 20 pt from the card edge.

xxl.$description: Inner horizontal padding of the owner's bubble: text starts 28 pt from its edge.

screenMargin.$description: Left and right margin of cards, menus and the composer when typing.

row.$description: Single-line settings row, divider to divider (rows.settings: dividers every 108 px).

rowTwoLine.$description: Settings row with a subtitle: the two-row Voice card is 358x166.5pt.

sidebarRow.$description: Sidebar row pitch: 44.1pt between label tops.

menuRow.$description: Single-line menu item pitch: 42.5pt. The model picker's two-line items are 60 pt.

navButton.$description: Round glass menu, close and back buttons (a circle; 45pt tall with the rim's soft edge). The account avatar beside them is the same size.

height.$description: Composer capsule height, empty or typed.

width.$description: Composer width while empty: it floats inset from the margins.

widthTyped.$description: Composer width once text is typed: it widens to the screen margins.

sendButton.$description: Send and voice buttons inside the composer: circles (40.5pt tall, voice 40pt wide).

width.$description: Selected pill of the Chat / Task toggle (white interior, rim excluded).

height.$description: Selected pill of the Chat / Task toggle.

button.$description: Full-width primary button (Get started, Try it): 341.5x52.5pt.

buttonTonal.$description: Filled capsule button with an icon (Add): 93x39pt.

buttonSignIn.$description: Google sign-in button at onboarding: 357x35pt, a rounded rectangle, not a capsule.

width.$description: Material switch (Memory): track width, anti-aliased edge excluded.
iOS switch (Voice): track width, anti-aliased edge excluded.

rowCard.$description: Capsule row card on the account sheet: 358x54pt.

suggestionCard.$description: Suggestion card with a title and a two-line description: 358x102.5pt dark, 358x103.5pt light.

mediaCard.$description: Video result card in a thread: its width, 24 pt from the left edge.

menuWidth.$description: Pull-down menu width (250pt); the model picker is 322.5pt tall with four models and a Thinking level row.

touchTarget.$description: Nav buttons, sidebar rows and the composer are 44 pt or more. The send and voice circles (40 pt), the Add button (39 pt) and the Chat / Task pill (29 pt) are smaller and sit in larger hit areas or rows.

hairline.$description: Dividers between grouped rows: one device pixel at 2x (border.divider reads a one-pixel row).

base.$description: Identified by eye from the letterforms (the round geometric G, a, y and the tittle shapes), not read from the app. Google's own typeface; it is not committed here, so the stack falls back to the platform sans.

regular.$description: Greetings, titles, body, rows, menus. Judged by stroke width, not measured.

medium.$description: Card titles, usage titles, the empty-state title, the PRO and Pro badges, nav titles. Judged by stroke width.

display.$description: The greeting on home and onboarding ('Let's jump in'), centred; the Task greeting wraps on this line height. Cap-height readings: 32pt, 33pt.

titleLarge.$description: Page titles: Settings, the Students and Memory headers. The 'S' has an overshoot, so the reading may be a point high. Cap-height readings: 28pt.

title.$description: Nav titles in a sheet ('Voice', 'Usage limits', 'Scheduled'). Cap-height readings: 17pt.

body.$description: Gemini's replies, the owner's bubble, composer text, settings and sidebar rows, search results, card titles, button labels. Cap-height readings: 17pt.

bodyStrong.$description: Empty-state titles ('No results') and card titles in bold ('Learning tailored to you'). Cap-height readings: 17pt.

subheadline.$description: Row subtitles, section headers, card descriptions, empty-state lines; medium for usage titles and the PRO badge. Cap-height readings: 15pt.

footnote.$description: The disclaimer under a thread ('Gemini is AI and can make mistakes'). Cap-height readings: 14pt.

caption.$description: Labels in the Chat / Task toggle. Cap-height readings: 13pt.

caption2.$description: Model descriptions in the model picker ('Fastest answers'). Cap-height readings: 12pt.

notTokenised: The home glow: a radial gradient rising from the bottom edge, blue in Chat and purple in Task (bg.glow and bg.glowTask hold its edge colour only)
iOS 26 glass (nav buttons, the composer, menus, the + sheet, the search field): blur and refraction come from the system material
The Gemini spark and the multicolour avatar ring at sign-in: artwork, not kept
Continuous (squircle) corners: DTCG has no value for corner smoothing
Shadows: light theme shows soft shadows under the composer, the segment pill and menus; they were not measured

page.$description: Home, chat threads, search, the sidebar and pushed pages. Pure black in dark.

sheet.$description: Settings and Usage sheets: the page colour.

sheetAccount.$description: The account sheet: a tinted grey, unlike the other sheets.

glow.$description: Bottom edge of the glow behind the home composer (Chat mode). The box's dominant colour covers 34% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

glowTask.$description: Bottom edge of the glow in Task mode: purple instead of blue. The box's dominant colour covers 29% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

scrim.$description: Black at 20%: the home page reads #FBF9F9 undimmed and #CAC6C7 under the + sheet.

raised.$description: Suggestion cards (Scheduled) and the study-notebook card (Students); the usage progress track.

container.$description: The owner's message bubble, the Usage cards and the PRO badge: a step off the page.

rowCard.$description: Capsule row cards on the account sheet (Manage your Google Account, Settings).

selected.$description: Current row in the sidebar (New chat): a full-width capsule. Not captured in light: the light sidebar was scrolled past it, so the light container colour is used.

glass.$description: Round glass buttons (menu, close, back, new chat) and the search field, centre reading. The material tints with what is behind it. The box's dominant colour covers 72% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

segment.$description: Selected pill of the Chat / Task toggle: black in dark, white in light.

menu.$description: Pull-down menus (model picker, chat menu), glass. The reading picks up what is behind the menu. The box's dominant colour covers 48% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

menuPopup.$description: Pop-up select menu over a card (Theme).

sheetPlus.$description: The + sheet: glass over the page, tinted by the glow. The box's dominant colour covers 73% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

tile.$description: Large tiles at the top of the + sheet (Photos, Camera, Avatar).

track.$description: Usage progress track (0% used): the raised colour inside a container card.

signIn.$description: Google sign-in sheet at onboarding. Not captured in light: onboarding was captured in dark only (the app was set to light afterwards, from Settings); the light card colour is used.

divider.$description: Hairline between grouped rows, inset to the row text. Cards have no rim.

primary.$description: Greetings, replies, the owner's bubble, row titles (reply text reads #000000).

onGlass.$description: Labels on glass: menu items and the Chat / Task labels (Task reads #060708). A touch brighter than text.primary in dark.

secondary.$description: Row subtitles and card descriptions. Readings in this role range #727272, #727373, #898789.

tertiary.$description: Section headers, timestamps, helper lines, the disclaimer. Readings range #706E6F, #716F6F, #727070.

onMenuSecondary.$description: Model descriptions inside the model picker (on glass).

link.$description: Inline links ('Learn more'): the same bright blue in both themes.

action.$description: Text buttons in a sheet header ('Done'): the Material primary blue.

danger.$description: Destructive menu items (Delete): red text and a red icon, never a red fill.

primary.$description: Google's Material primary: filled buttons (Add), the Material switch, the Done text. Light blue in dark, deep blue in light.

bright.$description: The bright system-style blue: links, the iOS switch, the dot after the model name, the avatar ring. One value in both themes.

dot.$description: Dot after the model name in the title (new-model hint). Not captured in light: no dot showed in the light captures, so the dark value is used (it matches accent.bright).

ring.$description: Ring around the account avatar (sidebar and account sheet). The box's dominant colour covers 12% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

caret.$description: Text caret in a focused field (composer, search): the only focus indicator. The box's dominant colour covers 19% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

bg.$description: Full-width primary button (Get started, Try it): a near-black capsule over the glow. Not captured in light: onboarding was captured in dark only (the app was set to light afterwards, from Settings); the light raised colour is used.

text.$description: Primary button label. Not captured in light: onboarding was captured in dark only (the app was set to light afterwards, from Settings); the light label-on-glass colour is used.

bg.$description: Filled capsule button with a leading icon (Add).

Google sign-in button (Continue as Kai): light blue, a rounded rectangle. Not captured in light: onboarding was captured in dark only (the app was set to light afterwards, from Settings); the light accent.primary is used.

text.$description: Google sign-in button label. Not captured in light: onboarding was captured in dark only (the app was set to light afterwards, from Settings); the light accent.onPrimary is used.

bg.$description: Send button once text is typed: a blue circle. The box's dominant colour covers 59% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.
Voice (Live) button while the composer is empty: a blue-tinted circle. The box's dominant colour covers 78% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

bgTask.$description: Voice button in Task mode: purple-tinted. The box's dominant colour covers 85% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

thumb.$description: Material switch thumb, on: holds a tick. The box's dominant colour covers 75% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

tick.$description: Tick on the Material switch's thumb.

onSystem.$description: iOS switch on (Voice): the bright blue, both themes.

danger.$description: Danger: red text on destructive items. No danger fill was seen.

info.$description: Info: the bright blue (links, the new-model dot).

notTokenised: Success and warning colours: no such state was seen
Pressed and disabled states: stills only, and no disabled control appeared
